review_text: The stars I give this game just keep going down. its my favorite mobile game and a go to for me when I have rare down time. But it is also the ONLY game I have ever played with so many technical issues. Constant loss of connection makes the game almost unplayable after spending money. Resulting in loss rewards and VIP time. There are consecutive days I can't play it because of the connection issue. I have a brand new phone (same problem on the old one), 5G data connection, and amazing wifi.

The game is great. The graphics are phenomenal. But the gameplay plays more for the people who are high levels. If you just starting out, Good luck getting off the ground. Hope your rich, cause that the only way your gonna level up in the beginning. Gameplay is fun, but ridiculously challenging. Anything and everything is costly and the more you spend, the slower it is to get upgraded. Bring your millions!! Dont try to contact the makers of the game to complain, your 1 of 1000's that do, so tough tots for you!

The game is great, but the user interface is completely rigged. Every time you open the game or go to the 1v1 section, it automatically scrolls and selects the highest possible bet table based on your coins. This is a cheap "Dark UX" trick to force accidental mis-clicks so players lose all their hard-earned coins and are forced to buy real ones. ​We need a "Default Table Lock" or the game should always open the lowest bet table by default, not the highest! Fix this scammy feature. Giving 1 star

This game is so bad. I'm playing it to complete a Money Cash offer (to beat Village 161 for $40 AUD) but it's so predatory and rigged. The spins you get from chests are always on the lower end. So many overpriced bundles. You constantly get dupes for cards even though there are 2/3 star cards you haven't got yet. And I can't stand the 8 screens you have to close out after you run out of spins. So many bots (in clan chat). Don't get how this game is 4.7/5, perhaps a lot of fake reviews too.
